summary: Bagisto is an open-source e-commerce framework built on PHP using the Laravel ecosystem. It provides core online store functionality including multi-inventory management, localized settings, taxation, and dropshipping workflows.
goodFor: Developers and merchants who want to build and customise an online store using the PHP and Laravel technology stack under an MIT licence.
watchOut: You will need to maintain your own PHP environment and database, and the framework shares space with numerous established e-commerce platforms which may offer larger plugin ecosystems.
deployNotes: You will typically deploy this on a standard PHP-compatible web server backed by a relational database such as MySQL or PostgreSQL, sitting behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
